llm.summary: This local note board mostly matches its stated purpose, but it promises no networking while automatically contacting clawhub.ai for update checks.

dimensions.detail: LocalStorage, IndexedDB, clipboard, file picker, drag-and-drop, and downloads are proportionate for the app, but the automatic outbound fetch is under-disclosed for a tool handling private notes and files.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a static single-file HTML app with no install-time scripts; the only packaging instruction is a manual skill-creator command.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The usage guidance covers expected note-board workflows, but it also uses broad trigger language and mentions packaging arbitrary HTML into a skill without clear boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent browser storage of notes, images, uploaded files, drafts, trash, folders, and update-check cache is disclosed and mostly purpose-aligned; no elevated OS privileges or background workers were found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core note, image, folder, local storage, and Word export features are coherent, but the HTML includes an automatic remote version check despite repeated local-only and no-network claims.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable with the app storing your notes, images, and uploaded files in browser storage and making an automatic update-check request to clawhub.ai. For sensitive notes or private files, ask the publisher to remove the background network request or make it explicit and opt-in.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Confirmed: the app claims no networking, but assets/word-doc.html performs a fetch to a clawhub.ai API endpoint for version data.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Confirmed in context: update checking is product-adjacent but not needed for the local organizer/exporter function and is not disclosed in the local-only description.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Partially confirmed: the description includes an unrelated broad case for turning HTML into an installable skill, which is wider than the specific note-board purpose.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially confirmed: the listed activation examples mostly fit the app, but they lack explicit exclusions and could over-trigger on general note-taking or packaging requests.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Confirmed: the version check runs automatically after page load rather than only after the user clicks the version label.
